subject: Deployment mode: SSO / KMS / Logging retention follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: deployment-mode / SSO / KMS / logging (post-demo)

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps on the deployment-mode questions you raised (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

1) SSO: You indicated Okta SAML is required for admin consoles and SCIM for user provisioning for compliance.
2) KMS/HSM: You need customer-managed keys (HSM-backed) for encryption of model logs and stored artifacts.
3) Logging retention: Security requires 7 years retention for audit logs in immutable storage (or exportable to your SIEM).

Impact on deployment mode (high level):
- Hosted API: simplest; supports OIDC/OAuth for API keys, but does not currently support customer-managed HSM for tenant keys or full private VPC log isolation.
- Dedicated: provides isolated GPU pools + some KMS integrations (bring-your-own KMS in our private tenants) — we typically can support HSM-backed CMKs for encryption at rest for Dedicated accounts, and can ingest logs to a customer-owned logging destination with retention controls.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full control — we can deploy a private control plane or on-prem image; supports Okta SAML, BYO-KMS/HSM, and full log-retention policies enforced inside your environment.

Attached: SSO_Specs.pdf (sample SCIM/SAML configs), KMS_Requirements.xlsx (fields we need), Logging_Retention_Questions.docx (initial questions from our side).

Next steps I propose:
- Can you confirm which internal stakeholders should be included for a short technical deep-dive? (Security + infra/ops).
- If you prefer, we can have Rishi (solutions engineer) run a Dedicated vs Private tradeoff call next week focused on your compliance checklist.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on what you need.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@fintechco.com>, Eddie Wang <eddie.wang@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode / SSO / KMS / logging (post-demo)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from security:

- When you say Dedicated supports BYO-KMS, is the key material ever accessible by Redwood operators? Our policy is zero-exposure to provider ops for customer CMKs.
- For log exports from Dedicated, can we push logs to our AWS account (S3 -> Glacier / Vault) with server-side encryption using our CMK?
- Hosted API is currently a non-starter for us unless we can guarantee HSM-backed CMK and VPC log egress — is that something you offer as an add-on?

Stakeholders for the deep dive: Bob (security), Eddie (platform infra), plus me. I'm available Tue 10/6 or Wed 10/7 after 1pm PT.

Also, can you provide one-pagers on the specific differences in guarantees (who has key access, where logs live, SLA differences) for Dedicated vs Private?

Best,
Alice
Director of Security, FintechCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode / SSO / KMS / logging (post-demo)

Alice — thanks, and good availability window. Rishi can do Tue 10/6 at 1:30pm PT — proposing a 45-min technical deep-dive (Rishi will cover KMS/HSM, logging export patterns, and sample configs).

High-level answers while we prepare the one-pagers:
- Dedicated BYO-KMS: we support envelope encryption with customer-managed keys. In our Dedicated tenancy model, key material never leaves the customer-managed HSM. Redwood only holds wrapped keys and operates blind to plaintext. We can include a documented KMS trust model and affirmation for your procurement/security.

- Log export: for Dedicated we offer push-based exports to customer-owned S3 buckets (delivery over TLS) and can apply server-side encryption using your CMK. We also support forwarding to Splunk/Datadog via your ingestion endpoints; retention is managed on your side.

- Hosted API: does not support customer HSM for tenant CMKs today; we can offer long-term roadmap conversations but not an immediate compliance fit.

- Private/VPC: full control — if you require attested HSM ownership and immutable, on-prem archival we recommend Private deployment. It also reduces the compliance burden since logs and keys remain in your environment.

Attachments: I pushed updated one-pager drafts to the DocSend link in the related_links — will finalize based on the deep-dive.

Proposed agenda for Tue 10/6 1:30pm PT:
- Quick intros (5m)
- KMS/HSM trust model + how we handle wrapped keys (15m)
- Log export patterns and retention options (10m)
- SSO/SCIM admin provisioning and RBAC mapping (10m)
- Q&A / next steps (5m)

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include Rishi and Dev.

—Marissa
From: Bob Lee <bob.lee@fintechco.com>

Marissa — appreciate the quick answers. A few specific ask items for the deep-dive so we can be prepared: 

1) A short diagram or explanation of the key lifecycle for Dedicated (who wraps/unwrapped keys, KMS calls flow).
2) Example policy JSON for the S3 delivery role and minimal bucket policy you expect customers to apply.
3) Can you confirm whether Redwood retains any plaintext logs for troubleshooting in Dedicated? If so, what is the maximum retention and access controls?

On our side we will bring our compliance checklist and the list of required attestations for third parties. If you can share the diagram and bucket policy before the call that would be helpful.

—Bob

Bob / Alice — thanks, noted. Action items: 

- Rishi will produce the key-lifecycle diagram and example S3 policy and drop it in the DocSend link by EOD today. (Rishi, filing as action.)
- Dev will prepare a short note confirming that Redwood does not retain plaintext customer logs in Dedicated tenants; any troubleshooting snapshots are encrypted and access-controlled.
- I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 10/6 1:30pm PT and include the draft materials ahead of the call.

If the call validates Dedicated meets your requirements, next steps would be: procurement PO -> Dedicated onboarding -> SOC2 evidence exchange -> final production acceptability testing. If Dedicated falls short on HSM attestation or immutable archival controls, we will discuss Private deployment options (timeline and pricing) during the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

—Marissa
